tasks.label: Tail Debug Log
args: log="$HOME\.claude\debug\latest"; log="${log//\\//}"; echo "Waiting for $log ..."; while [ ! -f "$log" ]; do sleep 0.5; done; echo "Found! Tailing..."; echo "cwd: $(pwd); shell: $0 " ; tail -F "$log"

tasks.label: Tail Diagnose Log
args: log="$HOME\.claude\debug\claude-diagnose.log"; log="${log//\\//}"; echo "Waiting for $log ..."; while [ ! -f "$log" ]; do sleep 0.5; done; echo "Found! Tailing..."; tail -F "$log"

tasks.label: Tail Frame-Timing Log
args: log="$HOME\.claude\debug\claude-frame-timing.log"; log="${log//\\//}"; echo "Waiting for $log ..."; while [ ! -f "$log" ]; do sleep 0.5; done; echo "Found! Tailing..."; tail -F "$log"

tasks.label: Tail MCP Logs
args: cache="${env:LOCALAPPDATA}\claude-cli-nodejs\Cache"; cache="${cache//\\//}"; echo "Searching for MCP logs in $cache ..."; while true; do files=$(find "$cache" -type f -path '*/mcp-logs-*/*.jsonl' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$files" ] && break; sleep 0.5; done; echo "Found MCP log(s):"; echo "$files"; echo '---'; tail -F $files
